submitted.rationale: Only 3 merit measurements were available, so I spread them along the Sb-Y line. At Sb 0.63 (idx 28) the EQE was 0.081%. At Sb 0.23 (idx 14) it was 0.105%. At Sb 0.34 (idx 18), the GP-UCB pick in between, it was 0.114%, the highest measured. All of these EQEs are low, which fits wide-gap Y/Sb oxides under 2.1 eV light. The response seems to peak at intermediate Sb content, around the Y3SbO7/YSbO4-type mixed region.
